scope: three isolated real-weight convolution layers; private recorded IR crops; strict FP32 ncnn oracle and FP16-input companion

tolerances.derivation: rtol=2^-10 (one FP16 ULP); atol=rtol*max_abs_bias+1e-4 FP32 reduction allowance; evaluated against ncnn with layer inputs rounded to FP16
tolerances.acceptance: every output finite; zero raw accumulator nonfinites; abs(DSP-qref)<=atol+rtol*abs(qref); full-reference allowance adds abs(qref-fullref); max absolute and RMS errors against original FP32 ncnn must also meet full_max_abs/full_rms
tolerances.full_reference_derivation: 1.25 times worst calibration-only sum of input-quantization and ideal final-FP16-store errors; max rounded up to 1e-4, RMS to 1e-5; heldout crops never set limits

fault_pilot.host_note: earlier host validation; final main runs add immutable bias checks and total FP32-error gates

repeatability.host_change: Normalize every checker exception to RecoveryRequired before reclamation; no native code/arithmetic or tolerance change

limitations: Two calibration and two heldout crops from one recording; manually selected hand/controller ROIs, contrast none
Layer inputs come from ncnn intermediates; DSP errors are not propagated through a complete landmark graph
Strict CPU FP32 oracle differs from production FrameTop ARM FP16 execution options; tracking accuracy remains unqualified
Native final FP16 HMX store followed by FP32 bias/clip; this differs from public per-depth FP32 partial accumulation
FP16 input quantization dominates the stem; total-error limits use only calibration CPU precision estimates plus 25 percent margin
Host lowers one 32-row patch tile at a time; no full im2col materialization; weights/bias remain resident per layer session
One HMX owner; existing 40 ms host timeout, code slot and per-request 8 KiB VTCM/power scope preserved
Command timing excludes input encoding and patch lowering; layer run timing excludes open/close and input preflight
Main counts exclude preliminary controls, earlier calibration without total-error gates, fault pilot and compatibility regressions
No raw frames, crops, model weights or tensor dumps are redistributed
